versions.changelog: Add Claude Code user-level skill install examples in README and SKILL.md; clarify CLI usage and output path.
Update SKILL/README guidance; align OpenClaw/ClawHub usage; prepare PyPI release workflow.

- Initial release: fetch and convert WeChat Official Account articles to clean Markdown files.
- Supports metadata extraction (title, author, publish date, source link).
- Automatically downloads article images to a local images/ directory and updates Markdown image paths.
- Accurately extracts and formats WeChat code blocks, including language detection and cleanup.
- Uses turndown for thorough HTML-to-Markdown conversion with formatting retention.
- Enables concurrent image downloads (default 5 at a time) for enhanced speed.
- Includes usage instructions and notes main limitations regarding WeChat anti-crawling measures.
